mapper.select: SELECT task_code, statistics_start_time, last_created_time, last_log_id FROM bt_dashboard_aggregation_checkpoint WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} FOR UPDATE

SELECT source_log.log_id, source_log.tenant_id, source_log.model_id, source_log.model_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(own_model.product_type, ''), NULLIF(platform_model.product_type, '')) AS product_type, source_log.created_time FROM ( SELECT log_id, tenant_id, model_id, model_name, created_time FROM bt_model_usage_log WHERE created_time IS NOT NULL AND created_time >= #{statisticsStartTime} AND created_time < #{cutoffTime} AND (created_time > #{lastCreatedTime} OR (created_time = #{lastCreatedTime} AND log_id > #{lastLogId})) UNION SELECT log_id, tenant_id, model_id, model_name, created_time FROM bt_model_usage_log_his WHERE created_time IS NOT NULL AND created_time >= #{statisticsStartTime} AND created_time < #{cutoffTime} AND (created_time > #{lastCreatedTime} OR (created_time = #{lastCreatedTime} AND log_id > #{lastLogId})) ) source_log LEFT JOIN bt_library_large_model own_model ON own_model.model_id = source_log.model_id AND source_log.tenant_id <> -1 AND own_model.tenant_id = source_log.tenant_id AND own_model.status_cd = '00A' LEFT JOIN bt_library_large_model platform_model ON platform_model.model_id = source_log.model_id AND platform_model.tenant_id = -1 AND platform_model.status_cd = '00A' ORDER BY source_log.created_time, source_log.log_id #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE bt_dashboard_model_usage_total SET invoke_count = invoke_count + #{increment}, model_name = COALESCE(#{modelName}, model_name), product_type = COALESCE(#{productType}, product_type), updated_time = WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND model_id = #{modelId}
UPDATE bt_dashboard_aggregation_checkpoint SET last_created_time = #{lastCreatedTime}, last_log_id = #{lastLogId}, updated_time = WHERE task_code = #{taskCode}
mapper.select: SELECT s.tenant_id, s.model_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model m WHERE m.model_id = s.model_id AND m.status_cd = '00A' AND m.tenant_id IN (s.tenant_id, -1) ) THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model disabled_model WHERE disabled_model.model_id = s.model_id AND disabled_model.tenant_id IN (s.tenant_id, -1) AND disabled_model.status_cd = '00D' ) THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model waiting_model WHERE waiting_model.model_id = s.model_id AND waiting_model.tenant_id IN (s.tenant_id, -1) AND waiting_model.status_cd = '00W' ) THEN 'WAITING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model deleted_model WHERE deleted_model.model_id = s.model_id AND deleted_model.tenant_id IN (s.tenant_id, -1) AND deleted_model.status_cd = '00X' ) THEN 'DELETED' WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model existing_model WHERE existing_model.model_id = s.model_id AND existing_model.tenant_id IN (s.tenant_id, -1) ) THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS model_status, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model own_model WHERE own_model.model_id = s.model_id AND s.tenant_id <> -1 AND own_model.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND own_model.status_cd = '00A' ) THEN 'CUSTOM' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model platform_model WHERE platform_model.model_id = s.model_id AND platform_model.tenant_id = -1 AND platform_model.status_cd = '00A' ) THEN 'PLATFORM' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model own_record WHERE own_record.model_id = s.model_id AND s.tenant_id <> -1 AND own_record.tenant_id = s.tenant_id ) THEN 'CUSTOM' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_library_large_model platform_record WHERE platform_record.model_id = s.model_id AND platform_record.tenant_id = -1 ) THEN 'PLATFORM' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS model_source, COALESCE( (SELECT NULLIF(own_product.product_type, '') FROM bt_library_large_model own_product WHERE own_product.model_id = s.model_id AND s.tenant_id <> -1 AND own_product.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND own_product.status_cd = '00A' 1), (SELECT NULLIF(platform_product.product_type, '') FROM bt_library_large_model platform_product WHERE platform_product.model_id = s.model_id AND platform_product.tenant_id = -1 AND platform_product.status_cd = '00A' 1) ) AS product_type FROM bt_dashboard_model_usage_total s ORDER BY s.last_status_check_time, s.tenant_id, s.model_id #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE bt_dashboard_model_usage_total SET model_status = #{modelStatus}, model_source = #{modelSource}, product_type = #{productType}, last_status_check_time = , updated_time = WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND model_id = #{modelId}
